name: Mutasim Billah
headline: ICT Undergraduate · Robotics & Embedded Systems
summary: ICT undergraduate at Bangladesh University of Professionals who designs and builds robots and ESP32-based devices, from wiring and firmware to competition day. Robo Soccer runners-up at the National Robotics Championship 2025. Learning PCB design and full-stack web development; seeking internships in embedded systems, robotics, or software.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Information and Communication Engineering

skills: C, C++, Java, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS
ESP32, Arduino, ESP-IDF, PD motor control, sensor arrays, I²C/SPI displays, nRF24 radios
Git, VS Code, Flask, SQLAlchemy, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MATLAB, Cisco Packet Tracer

projects.title: CPU Scheduler Visualizer
bullets: Handheld device that teaches CPU scheduling on two displays (SSD1306 OLED, 240×240 ST7789 IPS) and four buttons.
Five algorithms (FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Priority, Round Robin) with step-by-step playback, a live Gantt chart, waiting, turnaround, and response-time metrics, and a Compare All mode.

projects.title: Robo Soccer Robot
bullets: Designed and built a soccer robot from scratch and tested it for competition: runners-up at NRC 2025, 4th at IUBAT.

projects.title: Line-Following Robots (Mark-X, Head Hunter)
bullets: Made physical modifications, software changes, and firmware updates across several build iterations.
Mark-X firmware: PD control over a 16-sensor array read through an analog multiplexer, with a state machine for gaps, junction priority, inverted-line sections, and a finish-box auto-stop.

projects.title: ESP32 Wireless Signal Analyzer and Smart Clock
bullets: Wireless signal analyzer with an ST7789 display for Wi-Fi channel analysis and Bluetooth scanning.
Smart clock on an SSD1306 OLED with weather integration, animations, and power-saving features.

projects.title: Web Applications
bullets: Art Attack: Flask and SQLAlchemy art marketplace with team battles, moderation, checkout, and PDF receipts.
Restaurant Management System: Java web app with staff roles, reservations, orders, and billing.
Q-Less Printing (in progress): printing service for BUP built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

leadership.title: Technical Team Head
bullets: Led technical operations for a national-level engineering competition: setup, troubleshooting, and live coordination.

leadership.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Technical lead for the team developing SafetyPod, a safety device.

leadership.title: Workshop Contributor
bullets: Helped participants learn robot movement, control systems, and hardware integration in hands-on sessions.

achievements: Runners-up, Robo Soccer, National Robotics Championship 2025.
Top 10, Robo Fusion (UFTB) with Team DurontoJatra; qualified for the World SDG Challenge 2026, Kuala Lumpur.
4th place, Soccer Bot segment, IUBAT Robotics Competition · 5th place, Machine Mania 3.0, BUTEX.
